passages.note: Raatz listed as a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023).
Raatz voted Yea on HB 1608 final passage, 37-12.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 37 Education matters. Nay 12 Excused 1 Not Voting 0

passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: New IC 20-33-7.5 requires written parental notification of a name or pronoun/gender identity change request, with no danger exception.

rows.reasoning: As a Senate sponsor of HB 1608 (2023) who also voted Yea on its final passage (37-12), Raatz enacted new IC 20-33-7.5, which requires a school to 'notify in writing at least one (1) parent... of a request made by the student to change the student's... name; or... pronoun, title, or word to identify the student' with no exception for danger to the student, matching the rung 'Require staff to notify parents whenever a student asks to be treated as a different gender at school.'
